description_en: Modifies the description of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster to facilitate the maintenance and management of the cluster
description_zh: 修改指定集群的描述信息，方便集群的维护管理
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster-description --db-cluster-id amv-bp1r053byu48p0000 --db-cluster-description adb_test --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBClusterDescription

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

parameters.help_en:
The description of the cluster.

The description cannot start with `http://` or `https`.
The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length
